visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a graphic title card featuring a light blue background filled with faint tech icons. The central text is yellow and white, surrounded by small animated lightning and gear icons. No humans are present. The lighting is flat and uniform as expected for a graphic interface. (2) A macro close-up reveals a glossy black smartphone camera lens with intricate circular details. A white countdown digit '5' through '1' animates on top. A hand with manicured nails then holds the folded Samsung Galaxy Z Flip against a plain white background, showing its dual camera system and compact form. (3) The scene cuts to a close-up of a pinkish-purple camera bar with a large pill-shaped cutout. After a countdown from five to one, the camera pulls back to show a hand holding a Google Pixel phone in a bright pink color. The background is a simple, brightly lit indoor studio setting. (4) A close-up shows gray plastic buttons with the PlayStation square and triangle symbols, next to a microphone mute toggle. Following the five-second countdown, the full device is revealed as a PlayStation Portal handheld, held by a person's hand against a neutral, warm-toned wall background. (5) A macro shot focuses on the square lens of a black action camera with a rubberized texture. A digital countdown overlays the image. The camera is then shown being held by a hand; it is a GoPro Hero model. The background is a clean, white indoor surface with bright lighting. (6) A close-up of a black circular mesh ventilation grille on a white surface is shown during the countdown. The shot widens to reveal an Xbox Series S console sitting on a light wooden desk. Various black and white cables are visible in the background, along with a portion of a black monitor.

The entire track exhibits high dynamic compression typical of social media content, ensuring all sound effects and musical elements are clearly audible at a consistent volume.
